info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Tracks-v5-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Tracking API enables users to monitor the status and location of their food deliveries in real-time. It provides access to essential tracking information, making it easier for consumers to stay updated on their orders. This API is particularly useful for delivery partners, customer service representatives, and end-users who rely on accurate delivery information. With seamless integration, businesses can enhance their customer experience and optimize delivery logistics.

get.summary: Track the status of a delivery.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to track the current status of their deliveries by providing tracking information. It returns detailed updates regarding the delivery status and estimated arrival times.

requestBody.description: Request body for tracking deliveries. This should contain the necessary parameters to identify the specific delivery to be tracked.

200.description: Request completed successfully, delivery tracking information retrieved.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesTracksRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on deliveries track. It is a simple string type, used to convey necessary information.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesTracksResponse.title: Track Deliveries Response

status.description: Indicates whether the tracking operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the delivery.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the tracking result.

state.description: The current state of the delivery.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the tracking operation.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesTracksResponse.description: This schema represents the response structure for the Track Deliveries API, providing status and details about the tracking operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the record was created automatically by the system.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains information about the creation and modification of the delivery tracking record.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
